contracts.commit_point: agents/financial/agent.py:112-115 — invoke calls check_input_guardrails(user_input) and, if guardrail_triggered, logs and returns guardrail_message before constructing config/initial_state and before self.graph.invoke at line 126; a blocked input never reaches graph/tool execution.
contracts.declared_mechanism: check_input_guardrails(user_input) (agents/financial/guardrails.py:68-93): sequential screening returning (True, refusal_message) on detection — OFFENSIVE_PATTERNS regex search (71-74), PII_REQUEST_PATTERNS regex search (76-84), and OFF_TOPIC_KEYWORDS substring check exempted when any FINANCIAL_KEYWORDS substring is present (86-91); wired inline at the top of FinancialAgent.invoke (agents/financial/agent.py:111-115).
contracts.forbidden_condition: Unscreened user input that (a) matches any PII_REQUEST_PATTERNS regex (guardrails.py:29-40: account/bank/card number requests, ssn/passport/aadhaar/pan, phone/mobile/contact, email/address/dob/age, password/pin/cvv/otp/secret, ifsc/swift/bic/iban/routing, disclosure-verb requests, personal/private/sensitive-data requests), (b) matches any OFFENSIVE_PATTERNS regex (guardrails.py:49-51), or (c) contains an OFF_TOPIC_KEYWORDS term with no FINANCIAL_KEYWORDS substring (guardrails.py:42-47, 86-91), being passed into self.graph.invoke for agent/tool processing.
pending_binding_information: The implementation of retrieve_from_knowledge_base (tools/document_tools.py) is not supplied, so the downstream stratum of the conditional tool effect (file/database/http) cannot be refined beyond the invocation-level tool_execution stratum declared here.

config.get_llm and INFERENCE_PROVIDER are not supplied, so whether the unconditional agent LLM turn is a network (http) effect — which could justify a separate http-stratum contract at the same commit point — is unresolved.
Whether any outer caller wraps FinancialAgent.invoke or the graph as a registered tool for another agent, adding an outer dispatch binding, is not shown in the supplied views.
contracts.protected_operation: Execution of the FinancialAgent LangGraph pipeline on the user input: self.graph.invoke(initial_state, config=config) at agents/financial/agent.py:126, which runs the agent node (self.llm.invoke with the user message) and the conditionally dispatched ToolNode executing the registered retrieve_from_knowledge_base tool.
contracts.protected_resource: The financial agent's execution path registered at graph build time: the agent node (LLM inference) and the tools node (retrieve_from_knowledge_base), wired via StateGraph/ToolNode in _build_graph.
contracts.protection_obligation: FinancialAgent.invoke must invoke check_input_guardrails on the raw user_input before any agent graph/tool execution, and must not proceed to self.graph.invoke when the input triggers the guard; it must return the guardrail refusal message instead. The declared forbidden trigger classes are PII-request patterns, offensive-content patterns, and off-topic (non-financial) queries. (Merges the first-phase and second-phase reviewer wordings, which assert the same mechanism and commit point.)
scope_limits: The off-topic trigger fires only when no FINANCIAL_KEYWORDS substring appears anywhere in the input (guardrails.py:86-91), so queries mixing an off-topic term with any financial keyword pass the guard as declared.

Tool-node execution is conditional: tools_condition routes to the tools node only when the agent LLM emits a tool call (agent.py:100-105); crossing the commit point guarantees at least the agent LLM turn, not necessarily tool execution.
The guard screens only the user_input string supplied to FinancialAgent.invoke; no other ingress into the graph is screened by this mechanism.
This contract covers the code-registered guard only; the PII rules in FINANCIAL_SYSTEM_PROMPT (agent.py:16-69) are prompt-level instructions and are not relied on as the enforcement mechanism.

The forbidden condition as declared is limited to the enumerated regex/keyword lists; PII requests phrased outside PII_REQUEST_PATTERNS and off-topic inputs outside OFF_TOPIC_KEYWORDS are outside the declared forbidden condition.

contracts.commit_point: agents/financial/agent.py:137-142 — after check_output_guardrails runs, invoke either returns output_message (line 140, suppression committed) or returns output_content (line 142, disclosure committed); unredacted content must not cross line 142 when output_blocked is True.
contracts.declared_mechanism: check_output_guardrails(output_content) (agents/financial/guardrails.py:96-105): scans the serialized output against every PII_PATTERNS regex and returns (True, suppression_message) on the first match; agents/financial/agent.py:137-140 substitutes that message for the content before return.
contracts.forbidden_condition: Agent-generated final-message content containing any string matched by PII_PATTERNS (guardrails.py:7-27: SSN-like \d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}, 16/15/12/10/9-digit identifiers, email addresses, 'account/acct/a/c number ...' phrasings, IFSC-like tokens, IBAN-like tokens, 16-digit grouped card-like numbers, PAN-like, Aadhaar-like, phone-like, 'A/C No ...' and 'bank account no ...' phrasings, [A-Z]{4}\d{7}, [A-Z]{2}\d{6}, and any generic \b\d{6,}\b run) crossing the return of FinancialAgent.invoke to its caller.

contracts.protection_obligation: FinancialAgent.invoke must invoke check_output_guardrails on the serialized final agent message content before returning it to the caller, and must not return content that matches any PII_PATTERNS regex, returning the suppression message instead. (Merges the first-phase and second-phase reviewer wordings, which assert the same mechanism and commit point.)
scope_limits: The forbidden condition is exactly the PII_PATTERNS regex set; indirect or semantic PII disclosure styles prohibited by the system prompt (agent.py:50-52) are not code-detected by this mechanism.

PII_PATTERNS includes the generic \b\d{6,}\b pattern (guardrails.py:26), so the declared forbidden condition extends to any run of six or more digits, including ordinary financial figures appearing in responses.

Screening applies only to the string value returned by invoke; message content already written to the LangGraph checkpointer during self.graph.invoke (agent.py:106-107, 126) is outside this guard's commit point.
List-typed content is serialized by joining per-block text (agent.py:129-133); non-text modalities are outside the screened surface as declared.
